entries.title: Genesis 11:1
segments: ¶Now the whole earth had one language and one speech.

entries.title: Genesis 11:2
segments: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they dwelt there.

entries.title: Genesis 11:3
segments: Then they said to one another, "Come, let us make bricks and bake [them] thoroughly." They had brick for stone, and they had asphalt for mortar.

entries.title: Genesis 11:4
segments: And they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top [is] in the heavens; let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad over the face of the whole earth."

entries.title: Genesis 11:5
segments: ¶But the LORD came down to see the city and the tower which the sons of men had built.

entries.title: Genesis 11:6
segments: And the LORD said, "Indeed the people [are] one and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do; now nothing that they propose to do will be withheld from them.

entries.title: Genesis 11:7
segments: "Come, let Us go down and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another's speech."

entries.title: Genesis 11:8
segments: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there over the face of all the earth, and they ceased building the city.

entries.title: Genesis 11:9
segments: Therefore its name is called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth; and from there the LORD scattered them abroad over the face of all the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 11:10
segments: ¶This [is] the genealogy of Shem: Shem [was] one hundred years old, and begot Arphaxad two years after the flood.

entries.title: Genesis 11:11
segments: After he begot Arphaxad, Shem lived five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 11:12
segments: Arphaxad lived thirty-five years, and begot Salah.

entries.title: Genesis 11:13
segments: After he begot Salah, Arphaxad lived four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 11:14
segments: Salah lived thirty years, and begot Eber.

entries.title: Genesis 11:15
segments: After he begot Eber, Salah lived four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 11:16
segments: Eber lived thirty-four years, and begot Peleg.

entries.title: Genesis 11:17
segments: After he begot Peleg, Eber lived four hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 11:18
segments: Peleg lived thirty years, and begot Reu.

entries.title: Genesis 11:19
segments: After he begot Reu, Peleg lived two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 11:20
segments: Reu lived thirty-two years, and begot Serug.

entries.title: Genesis 11:21
segments: After he begot Serug, Reu lived two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 11:22
segments: Serug lived thirty years, and begot Nahor.

entries.title: Genesis 11:23
segments: After he begot Nahor, Serug lived two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 11:24
segments: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and begot Terah.

entries.title: Genesis 11:25
segments: After he begot Terah, Nahor lived one hundred and nineteen years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 11:26
segments: Now Terah lived seventy years, and begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

entries.title: Genesis 11:27
segments: ¶This [is] the genealogy of Terah: Terah begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran begot Lot.

entries.title: Genesis 11:28
segments: And Haran died before his father Terah in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.

entries.title: Genesis 11:29
segments: Then Abram and Nahor took wives: the name of Abram's wife [was] Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran the father of Milcah and the father of Iscah.

entries.title: Genesis 11:30
segments: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

entries.title: Genesis 11:31
segments: And Terah took his son Abram and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, his son Abram's wife, and they went out with them from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran and dwelt there.

entries.title: Genesis 11:32
segments: So the days of Terah were two hundred and five years, and Terah died in Haran.
